name: esc_yields_literal_hole_not_a_hole
note: THE crucial escape vector: the escape consumes all three characters, so the { can never open a hole and ${a} is text.

name: esc_no_escape_of_escape_regress
note: Leftmost-longest: position 0 is $$ followed by $ (not {), so it is a literal $; positions 1-3 are the escape. Yields $ then ${.

name: esc_double_dollar_alone
note: No { follows, so neither $ is an escape — both are literal text.

name: esc_empty_braces_after_escape
note: ${} is a malformed hole (parse-errors.json) but is literal text when escaped.

name: esc_then_real_hole
note: An escape and a real hole in one template — the escaped text and the live reference must not bleed into each other.
